title: part.transposition never enters the fret arithmetic
description: The part carries the standard guitar transposition block (written an octave above sounding, halfSteps -12) and two bare half notes sounding C3 and E3. MNX pitch is the SOUNDING pitch, so the derived frets are (5,3) and (4,2) — identical to the same notes without the block. The transposition is display metadata for written-pitch notation; a derivation that consumed it would come out 12 frets sharp. Pins the resolution of spec-instrument-position.md precondition 1.
